$comment: Runtime-extracted design tokens from https://www.siteaudits.ai/ — captured 2026-08-23 via ui-clone discovery (Playwright computed styles). This is REFERENCE EVIDENCE, not WebAudit AI's design system. See /DESIGN.md for ours.

source.method: getComputedStyle over all rendered elements, frequency-ranked

accent.note: Single accent. Used for CTA fill, headline emphasis span, focus ring, chat launcher, logo.

family.$note: Variable font, weight axis 100-900. Loaded remotely. One family for the entire site — no serif, no separate display face.

typography.$observation: Negative tracking on display sizes only (-1.2px hero, -0.9px h2); positive tracking on the uppercase eyebrow (+1.52px). Body sizes stay at normal. This is the single most transferable typographic decision on the site.

radius.$observation: 215 of ~250 styled elements have zero radius. Rounding is reserved for interactive controls and cards only. The overall impression is deliberately square.

elevation.$observation: Only three shadows on a 7134px page. Depth is carried by background tint changes (#ffffff / #fafafa / #f9fafb), not by shadow.

gradient.cornerWashBR: linear-gradient(to bottom right, rgba(234,88,12,0.4), transparent, transparent)
gradient.cornerWashTL: linear-gradient(to left top, rgba(234,88,12,0.5), transparent, transparent)

layout.$note: max-w-4xl. Unusually narrow for a marketing page — forces single-column reading and short line lengths.

motion.$observation: Colour-only transitions at framework-default timing. No scroll-triggered animation, no GSAP, no reveal-on-scroll, no parallax detected. The ui-clone animation pipeline has nothing to reproduce here.

urlInput.$note: 64px left padding reserves space for an inline prefix affordance.

stack.detected: Tailwind CSS utility classes; colour values match Tailwind's default palette (gray-800 #1f2937, gray-500 #6b7280, emerald-500 #10b981, orange-500 #f97316, red-500 #ef4444)

notablyAbsent: Top navigation bar — the homepage has no nav at all
Social proof beyond a single Product Hunt badge
